newsitem.title: UK: European Diary for Advertising & Media-to March 23.
newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media-to March 23.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - TO March 23
The following is a one-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.
LONDON - London International Book Fair '97, Olympia Grand and National Halls. (second day of three-day exhibition).
LONDON - Pearson Plc releases full-year 1996 results.
LONDON - "It Pays to Advertise" conference and exhibition, Olivier Theatre and Foyers, Royal National Theatre, South Bank.
LONDON - Dorling Kindersley Holdings Plc releases full-year 1996 results.
LONDON - Telewest Communications releases full-year 1996 results.
LONDON - Deadline for entries for The Marketing Telemarketing Awards 1997. Contact: (44) 171 413 4161.
LONDON - Deadline for entries in Newslink Radio Creative Award. Contact: (44) 1628 666 039.
GRANADA, Spain - International Press Institute World Congress & 46th General Assembly. Contact: (43) 1 512 9011 (first day of four-day conference).

Please send entries to: Reuters Advertising & Media Diary, Advertising Newsdesk, Reuters Ltd, 85 Fleet Street (GIR/1), London EC4P 4AJ; fax (44) 171 542 2929; telephone (44) 171 542 2792; email: adnewslon@reuters.com.
